Description
Dry-dock overhaul of the port-side main engine gearbox and replacement of the
stern tube seals on the passenger ferry "Aisling na Mara", IMO 9044718, carried
out at our yard between 20 April and 7 May 2026.

Item Qty Amount (EUR)
Labour, fitters 212 h € 18.020,00
Gearbox bearings 1 set € 9.460,00
Stern tube seals 2 € 4.250,00
Dock hire, 9 days 9 € 6.750,00
Class surveyor 1 € 1.180,50
Total excl. VAT € 39.660,50
VAT 0% € 0,00
Total due € 39.660,50

VAT reverse-charged to the customer under Article 44 of VAT Directive
2006/112/EC. An advance of EUR 15,000 was received on 17 April 2026 against pro-
forma PF-2026-0092 and is NOT deducted above; balance now payable is €
24.660,50.

Payment
Please pay within 30 days to Noordzee Handelsbank N.V., Rotterdam.

IBAN: NL48 RABO 0447 1882 03

BIC: NZHBNL2R

Quote the invoice number. Late payment interest runs at the statutory
commercial rate.

Notes
The seal housings showed scoring consistent with the grounding off Inis Oírr in
February that Ms. Ní Bhraonáin mentioned; we recommend a shaft alignment
check at the next docking. Warranty on parts is twelve months. Our work is
certified to ISO 9001; delivery terms per Incoterms do not apply to services.
